notes: Pose: Animate: keyframes on a timeline, as in Blender: pose, move on, pose again; it eases in between, a planted foot stays planted, and clothes and hair follow as it plays (Auto key, drag keys along, save as a video)
Pose: a motion file can become keys (To keys), to change any moment of it

Pose: clothes sewn from patterns, as real ones are made: a T-shirt, shorts, trousers, a skirt or a dress cut to the figure's measurements, laid round it flat and sewn shut; the pattern beside the 3D view, sewn again as you change it; elastic waistbands, piping, a woven look
Pose: ready-made clothes hold to the skin as the figure moves (shorts and shirts sitting down); buttons and flies stay on the cloth
Model: the header stays on one row; the colours fold into one swatch when there isn't room
